insurer_name: Niva Bupa Health Insurance Company Limited
residency_requirement: Indian resident; global cover for allopathic; AYUSH limited to India
sub_limits_waiting_notes: PED 36 months; specific waiting 24 months for listed conditions; maternity if opted

inpatient_hospitalization.limit_text: No room rent or ICU cap. Choose any room. Hospitalisation for 2+ hours including all day-care procedures.

day_care_treatments.limit_text: All day care + 12 Modern Treatments (robotic, stem cell, deep brain stimulation, etc.)

domiciliary_treatment.notes: Home Care for chronic conditions with daily monitoring; peritoneal dialysis and chemotherapy at home covered

ayush_coverage.limit_text: Up to Base Sum Insured (AYUSH covered only in India)

ambulance_cover.limit_text: Road and Air ambulance up to Base Sum Insured (Air ambulance in emergency only)

maternity_coverage.notes: Optional in some variants; not in base

organ_donor_expenses.notes: Donor harvesting expenses covered when insured undergoes covered transplant; also covered when insured donates an organ

restoration_benefit.limit_text: ReAssure+ Forever: unlimited sum insured restoration on first claim; max per claim = Base SI
restoration_benefit.notes: Triggers on first paid claim and stays for life if renewed without break

preventive_health_checkup.limit_text: Annual health checkup from Day 1 (cashless only via app); comprehensive panel including CBC, lipid, LFT, KFT, ECG, TMT/2D-Echo, USG, mammogram, PAP smear, colonoscopy >50

worldwide_emergency_cover.limit_text: Allopathic treatments covered anywhere in the world (Borderless benefit)

notable_exclusions_summary: Borderless allopathic cover globally; AYUSH limited to India. No room rent cap. Lock-the-Clock locks premium age at entry until first claim. ReAssure+ Forever gives unlimited SI refills.
claim_process_summary: Cashless via Niva Bupa network; pre-auth within 1 hour, final discharge within 3 hours. App-based health checkup booking. Reimbursement via web portal for non-network providers.
